description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate farm yard buildings arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell, two upgrade levels side by side (left basic, right upgraded and grander). Row 1: a small wooden greenhouse, a big glass greenhouse with a white iron frame; a simple stone well with a bucket, a fancy stone well with a tiled roof and a pulley. Row 2: a small wooden windmill, a tall stone windmill with big sails; a small wooden storage shed, a big red barn-style storehouse. Row 3: a small wooden fishing dock, a long wooden pier with lanterns; a simple wooden garden gate arch, a grand stone garden gate arch covered in flowering vines. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
